items.details: Evening Hiriketiya outing: creator describes a Secret Jungle Party bus pickup from Centre Point Hotel. She recommends the bus experience more than the party itself. Mentioned 19:00–23:30 schedule is historical and unverified today.
Galle lanes, cafés, boutiques, evening lights and gelato; gelato shop unnamed.
Suggests The Doctor's House, Hakuna Matata or Crust for evening plans, or relaxing at the villa. These are options, not evidence of visiting all three.
Spa/deep-tissue massage. A sign is visible around 68 seconds but its business identity/spelling is not confidently resolved; do not substitute Spa Ceylon (a separate Galle storefront shown earlier).
Shopping at Kai Boutique and Cactus, as named in narration.
